arxiv-2105-00347.title: Machine Learning-based Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface-aided MIMO Systems The research has been supported in part by Academy of Finland under 6Genesis Flagship (grant 318927) and EERA Project (grant 332362). Corresponding author: N. T. Nguyen (email: nhan.nguyen@oulu.fi).
arxiv-2105-00347.creator: Nhan Thanh Nguyen 1 , Ly V. Nguyen 2 , Thien Huynh-The 3 , Duy H. N. Nguyen 4 , A. Lee Swindlehurst 5 , and Markku Juntti 1
arxiv-2105-00347.description: Abstract Reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) technology has recently emerged as a spectral- and cost-efficient approach for wireless communications systems. However, existing hand-engineered schemes for passive beamforming design and optimization of RIS, such as the alternating optimization (AO) approaches, require a high computational complexity, especially for multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) systems.

arxiv-2108-01770.title: Atomic scale control of spin current transmission at interfaces
arxiv-2108-01770.creator: Mohamed Amine Wahada, Ersoy Şaşıoğlu, Wolfgang Hoppe, Xilin Zhou, Hakan Deniz, Reza Rouzegar, Tobias Kampfrath, Ingrid Mertig, Stuart S. P. Parkin, Georg Woltersdorf
arxiv-2108-01770.description: Abstract Spin transmission at ferromagnet/heavy metal interfaces is of vital importance for many spintronic devices. Usually the spin current transmission is limited by the spin mixing conductance and loss mechanisms such as spin memory loss. In order to understand these effects, we study the interface transmission when an insulating interlayer is inserted between the ferromagnet and the heavy metal.

arxiv-2204-02178.title: A Hilbert reciprocity law on 3-manifolds
arxiv-2204-02178.creator: Hirofumi Niibo, Jun Ueki
arxiv-2204-02178.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hirofumi Niibo, Jun Ueki. Based on our homological idelic class field theory, we formulate an analogue of the Hilbert reciprocity law on a rational homology 3-sphere endowed with an infinite link, in the spirit of arithmetic topology; We regard the intersection form on the unitary normal bundle of each knot as an analogue of the Hilbert symbol at each prime ideal to formulate the Hilbert reciprocity law, ensuring that cyclic covers of links are analogues of Kummer extensions.

arxiv-2305-00763.title: SGX Switchless Calls Made Configless
arxiv-2305-00763.creator: Peterson Yuhala, Michael Paper, Timothée Zerbib, Pascal Felber, Valerio Schiavoni, Alain Tchana
arxiv-2305-00763.description: Abstract Intel’s software guard extensions (SGX) provide hardware enclaves to guarantee confidentiality and integrity for sensitive code and data. However, systems leveraging such security mechanisms must often pay high performance overheads. A major source of this overhead is SGX enclave transitions which induce expensive cross-enclave context switches.

arxiv-2311-06744.title: Cotton Gravity: the cosmological constant as spatial curvature
arxiv-2311-06744.creator: Roberto A. Sussman, Sebastián Nájera
arxiv-2311-06744.description: Abstract We derive Friedman-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) models as non-trivial solutions of “Cotton Gravity” (CG), a recently proposed gravity theory alternative to General Relativity (GR) based on the Cotton tensor. Using an equivalent formulation, we show that CG leads to FLRW models with a modified expression for spatial curvature in terms of the Ricci scalar of hypersurfaces orthonormal to the 4-velocity.

arxiv-2401-10062.title: Shear profile in a dense packing of large grains Journal: Powder Technology
arxiv-2401-10062.creator: Alessio Quaresima a, Andrea Plati b,c,d, Andrea Gnoli c,d, Alberto Petri c,d,e
arxiv-2401-10062.description: Abstract We investigate the shear of a dense bed of refracting supermillimetric grains confined within a transparent horizontal annular cell with a rotating top. The local time correlation functions of interferometric images allow to characterize the shear profile close to the wall, with a spatial resolution well below the grain diameter.

arxiv-2405-07365.title: MULTIDEGREES OF BINOMIAL EDGE IDEALS
arxiv-2405-07365.creator: Jacob Cooper, Ethan Leventhal
arxiv-2405-07365.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jacob Cooper, Ethan Leventhal. Let G G be a simple graph with binomial edge ideal J G J_{G} . We prove how to calculate the multidegree of J G J_{G} based on combinatorial properties of G G . In particular, we study the set 𝒮 min ⁡ ( G ) \operatorname{\mathcal{S}_{min}}(G) defined as the collection of subsets of vertices whose prime ideals have minimum codimension.

Among these galaxies, we identify a remarkable galaxy at z = 9.25 z=9.

arxiv-2503-16782.title: Learning Part Knowledge to Facilitate Category Understanding for Fine-Grained Generalized Category Discovery
arxiv-2503-16782.creator: Enguang Wang, Zhimao Peng, Zhengyuan Xie, Haori Lu, Fei Yang, Xialei Liu
arxiv-2503-16782.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Enguang Wang, Zhimao Peng, Zhengyuan Xie, Haori Lu, Fei Yang, Xialei Liu. Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to classify unlabeled data containing both seen and novel categories. Although existing methods perform well on generic datasets, they struggle in fine-grained scenarios. We attribute this difficulty to their reliance on contrastive learning over global image features to automatically capture discriminative cues, which fails to capture the subtle local differences essential for distinguishing fine-grained categories.

hering-guiding-symptoms-vol6-1882.creator: Constantine Hering
hering-guiding-symptoms-vol6-1882.description: Constantine Hering's The Guiding Symptoms of Our Materia Medica, vol. VI (1882) — the great American materia medica: guiding symptoms arranged by bodily region, the clinical distillation of a lifetime's provings.

pmc-10639060.title: Additional principles that govern the release of pre-ribosomes from the nucleolus into the nucleoplasm in yeast
pmc-10639060.creator: Amber J LaPeruta, Jelena Micic, John L Woolford Jr.
pmc-10639060.description: During eukaryotic ribosome biogenesis, pre-ribosomes travel from the nucleolus, where assembly is initiated, to the nucleoplasm and then are exported to the cytoplasm, where assembly concludes. Although nuclear export of pre-ribosomes has been extensively investigated, the release of pre-ribosomes from the nucleolus is an understudied phenomenon.

pmc-10671312.title: The Release of Grape Pomace Phenolics from Alginate-Based Microbeads during Simulated Digestion In Vitro: The Influence of Coatings and Drying Method
pmc-10671312.creator: Josipa Martinović, Jasmina Lukinac, Marko Jukić, Rita Ambrus, Mirela Planinić, Gordana Šelo, Gabriela Perković, Ana Bucić-Kojić
pmc-10671312.description: Grape pomace is a byproduct of wineries and a sustainable source of bioactive phenolic compounds. Encapsulation of phenolics with a well-chosen coating may be a promising means of delivering them to the intestine, where they can then be absorbed and exert their health-promoting properties, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anticancer, cardioprotective, and antimicrobial effects.

pmc-10712086.title: Challenging experiences of the elderly with heart failure in the COVID-19 pandemic: a phenomenological study in Iran
pmc-10712086.creator: Arash Ziapour, Javad Yoosefi Lebni, Fatemeh Mohammadkhah, Fakhreddin Chaboksavar, Parisa Janjani, Murat Yıldırım
pmc-10712086.description: BackgroundPatients with heart failure (HF), especially the elderly, faced many challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic, which need to be explored. The present study aimed to analyse the challenging experiences facing the elderly with heart failure during the pandemic in Iran. To achieve this aim, a qualitative approach to research was employed.

pmc-11532858.title: Grammatical gender universalities underlying uniform mental representations of the world: Myth or reality?
pmc-11532858.creator: Elena Dubenko
pmc-11532858.description: The subject of grammatical gender and cognition has been continuously examined in psycholinguistics, wherein findings show essential support for gender congruency effects, suggesting that grammar lends matrices for speakers’ mental representations. Based on these psycholinguistic data, this study offers an innovative vista of investigation that combines typological and cognitive linguistic approaches.

pmc-12365024.title: Performance evaluation of GPT-4o on South Korean national exams for building mechanical equipment maintenance
pmc-12365024.creator: Haneul Choi, Jehyun Lee, Jonghun Kim
pmc-12365024.description: This study evaluates the applicability of large language models (LLMs) in mechanical equipment maintenance in buildings by assessing GPT-4o’s performance on two national certification exams in South Korea: Engineer Energy Management (EEM) and Engineer Air-Conditioning Refrigerating Machinery (EACRM). GPT-4o achieved average scores of 80.6 and 81.25 on the EEM and EACRM exams, respectively, passing all five attempts.

pmc-12506942.title: Burden of Myelodysplastic Syndromes: A Literature Review of Epidemiological and Humanistic Aspects
pmc-12506942.creator: Shitong Xie, Jiajun Yan, Preston Tse, Brittany Humphries, Feng Xie
pmc-12506942.description: ucial. Despite several reviews that have examined epidemiological or humanistic burden of MD, existing literature is often limited in scope, focusing on specific subgroups, for example, higher‐risk MDS, or single geographic regions. Furthermore, heterogeneous study methodologies have led to inconsistent estimates of MDS incidence, prevalence, and mortality, complicating comparisons across populations.

pmc-12598589.creator: Giorgio W Canonica, Diego Bagnasco, Jason K Lee, Geoffrey Chupp, Florence Schleich, John J Oppenheimer, Lingjiao Zhang, Rafael Alfonso-Cristancho, Peter Howarth
pmc-12598589.description: Graphical abstract Overview of the study. pmc-12612155.title: Halftone-encoded 4D printing of stimulus-reconfigurable binary domains for cephalopod-inspired synthetic smart skins
pmc-12612155.creator: Haoqing Yang, Haotian Li, Juchen Zhang, Tengxiao Liu, H. Jerry Qi, Hongtao Sun
pmc-12612155.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Cephalopods exhibit versatile control over their optical appearance, texture, and shape for adaptive camouflage and signaling. Achieving such multi-feature dynamic control in synthetic materials remains a significant challenge. Here, we introduce a halftone-encoded 4D printing method that enables simultaneous and programmable control over optical appearance, mechanical properties, surface texture, and shape transformation within a single smart hydrogel film in response to various external stimuli (e.g., temperature, solvents, and mechanical stress)—a capability beyond existing synthetic materials.

pmc-12657985.title: Passive air sampling detects environmental DNA transfer from water into air
pmc-12657985.creator: Yin Cheong Aden Ip, Gledis Guri, Elizabeth Andruszkiewicz Allan, Ryan P Kelly
pmc-12657985.description: Water and air are generally treated as separate reservoirs of environmental DNA (eDNA) derived from the species resident in those respective environmental compartments. However, it is likely that eDNA routinely crosses the air–water boundary in both directions as a result of deposition, evaporation, or other processes.

pmc-13152942.title: Second contralateral hip fractures reduce survival, mobility and daily activity : a matched pair analysis
pmc-13152942.creator: Alisa Blattner, Florian Sabath, Timon Röttinger, Leonhard Lisitano, Edgar Mayr, Annabel Fenwick
pmc-13152942.description: BackgroundHip fractures in older adults are associated with substantial morbidity, functional decline, and mortality. Patients who experience a first fragility fracture are at high risk of subsequent fractures, with repeated events further exacerbating functional impairment and survival outcomes. Second contralateral hip fractures, while clinically important, remain under-characterized in terms of timing, long-term functional impact, and mortality.

pmc-13360516.title: Interactions between taste and oral microbiome: mechanisms and implications for oral and systemic diseases
pmc-13360516.creator: Mengpei Xi, Shaoying Li, Yumu Tang, Jianhui Zhu, Shuli Deng
pmc-13360516.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe oral microbiome is a complex microbial ecosystem that contributes to oral and systemic health. pmc-13383982.creator: Shengyou Chen, Shaochuan Feng, Wangxi Ni, Yutao Pei, Xiaoyan Wang, Xinze Zhang
pmc-13383982.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026).
